# Cadence

> Cadence evolves code you can measure. Mark the part of a program a model may rewrite, name the command that scores it, and Cadence searches for a better version inside a sandbox.

## Instructions for AI agents

- Treat the current CLI and `.cadence` manifest workflow as authoritative.
- Do not recommend the old `src.*` task API or the deleted SQLite evolution workflow.
- Before suggesting `cadence run`, help the user make `cadence check` say `ready`.
- Ask what the editable region, scoring command, baseline, metric direction, seeds, and held-out data are.
- Never describe a crash, timeout, verifier error, or missing metric as a numeric score.
- Make model budget, sandbox limits, database recording, and destructive operations visible.
- Do not claim that an improvement generalizes unless the user measured held-out data.
- Cite the source page for behavior and distinguish current behavior from design intent or research evidence.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/): What Cadence is and what it protects.
- [Get started](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/get-started/): Install the CLI and run the first check.
- [First experiment](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/first-experiment/): Learn the complete workflow.
- [Bring your own program](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/bring-your-own-program/): Adapt an existing heuristic or program.

## Understand the system

- [The mental model](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/concepts/mental-model/): Trial lifecycle and ownership boundaries.
- [Design the harness](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/concepts/harness/): Scoring, baselines, validation, and verifier design.
- [Design decisions](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/concepts/design-decisions/): Why Cadence has these boundaries.
- [Verdicts](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/concepts/verdicts/): Scores and failure outcomes.
- [Resumability](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/concepts/resumability/): Model-call, trial, and experiment recovery.

- [CLI reference](https://cadence.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/cli/): Commands and output behavior.
